dataRecords.title: Emergency Safety & Evacuation SOP Guideline
dataRecords.content:
# DATIAN SUBIC SHOES INC. - EMERGENCY PROTOCOL

## 1. Scope & Objective
This standard operating procedure mandates immediate response steps during seismic events, electrical hazards, or chemical containment.

## 2. Immediate Actions:
- Line Supervisors must halt production lines immediately.
- Designated floor marshals guide all staff toward Assembly Area Alpha & Beta.
- Roll call must be executed within 3 minutes of alarm sounding.

## 3. Communication Channel:
Emergency radio channel Frequency 4; direct line to Subic Bay Health & Safety Marshall.
